name: Input Stage
description: Receives threat-populated canonical graph from Agent 05

name: Packaging Stage
description: Transforms threat data into STIX 2.1 compliant bundle objects

name: Output Stage
description: Emits STIX 2.1 bundle JSON to orchestrator for download

name: Graph Fetcher
description: Retrieves threat-populated canonical graph from Agent 05 state; extracts system identity threats and mitigations

name: STIX Object Builder
description: Constructs STIX 2.1 objects: identity (system) attack-pattern (threats) course-of-action (mitigations) relationship (uses mitigates)

name: Validation Engine
description: Validates STIX objects: required fields (type id spec_version created modified) UUID format relationship reference integrity schema compliance

name: STIX Bundler
description: Creates STIX 2.1 bundle wrapper containing all identity attack-pattern course-of-action and relationship objects

name: JSON Emitter
description: Serializes STIX bundle to JSON; returns to orchestrator for file download
